method: Automated inventory read every source, evidence, pathway, profile and review record in the exact manifest candidate for this ISO.

Automated screening compared source references, locators, geography fields, evidence class, direction, status, horizon and scenario; it checked pathway support IDs, link-evidence sets, geography fields, alternatives and uncertainty for follow-up.

Raw extraction access rows are recorded only as inherited access observations. This generated screen does not treat snippets, HTTP success, prior access, or metadata as claim verification and does not replace semantic source review.

evidence.compact_statement: The CCDR says climatic pressures could widen rural-urban and north-south gaps, compounding northern insecurity and displacement, including Sahelian in-migration.

source_refs.locator: Chapter 5, section 5.1.1, printed p. 51 (PDF p. 64), EHCVM 2018/19 household-shock paragraph.

evidence.compact_statement: In EHCVM 2018/19, 21.4% of households reported a climate-induced shock during the previous three years; 10.5% reported flood impacts and 12% drought impacts.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Chapter 5, section 5.1.1, printed p. 51 (PDF p. 64), paragraphs on differential household impacts.

evidence.compact_statement: Poor, rural and agriculture-reliant households reported greater exposure to climate shocks; over 36% of agriculture-reliant households reported flood and/or drought impacts, versus about 21% overall.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.
